newsitem.title: USA: RTRS-Clinton wins U.S. election - television.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Clinton wins U.S. election - television.

text.p: President Bill Clinton won the U.S. election on Tuesday, beating Republican Bob Dole and becoming the first Democrat to win a second term in 52 years, U.S. television networks said.
They said computer projections showed Clinton had won enough states to give him the 270 electoral college votes necessary for victory.
Clinton, 50, was the first Democrat to win re-election since Franklin Delano Roosevelt in 1944.
